issues.title: getKey(nil) on every key press
issues.note: FHbindings[1] is a header with no value, and FHhandleKeybinds asks core:getKey for every entry on each key press: Java throws a NullPointerException ("keybindID" is null) and logs it, hundreds of times a session (holding the right mouse button adds more). The Studio's shim answers getKey(nil) with nil without asking Java (part 6, the guards on the game's own code), as the game would after logging; the mod works the same. Checked in the game on 42.21, 2026-10-30.
issues.log: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "zombie.input.KeybindId.getId()" because "keybindID" is null at zombie.core.Core.getKey(Core.java:3023)
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, verified in the game's console.txt on 42.21 (2026-10-30)

issues.title: Hidden indicators take the clicks at the top-left of the screen
issues.note: Auto-hidden indicators are moved to -20000 and kept visible; 42.21 keeps top-level UI on the screen (ISUIElement:setX clamps to 0), so they pile up at 0,0, invisible, over the equipped-item icons: right-clicking the primary hand does nothing. The Studio's shim lets them leave the screen while hidden (patch modern_status). Checked in the game on 42.21, 2026-10-30: 22 indicators at 0,0, none after the patch.
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, checked in the game on 42.21 (2026-10-30)

issues.log: ERROR: ... attempted index: ISPathFindAction of non-table
issues.note: NeatLockpick_Unlock.lua uses ISPathFindAction without requiring "Vehicles/TimedActions/ISPathFindAction" first; whether it is loaded depends on what ran before. The log line names no mod (KahluaThread.call > require), so the Monitor can blame a neighbour. The Studio package carries the file with the require added.

issues.title: findAimTarget calls getMaxRange on an item that is not a weapon
issues.note: Its OnPlayerUpdate handler keeps looking for a tank to shoot while an attack is under way, even when the item in the hand is not a firearm; findAimTarget then calls weapon:getMaxRange(), which only weapons have. The Studio's shim answers no target when the hand holds no ranged weapon (patch propane_explosion). Reproduced and checked in the game on 42.21, 2026-10-30.
issues.log: ERROR: General f:188498> Lua((MOD:Propane Explosion)).findAimTarget> Exception thrown java.lang.RuntimeException: Object tried to call nil in findAimTarget
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, checked in the game on 42.21 (2026-10-30)
